name: Philosophy (Domain)
body:
Deity/Ideal: Elevation of Man

Granted Powers: For a total time per day of 1 round/cleric level you possess, you can act normally regardless of magical effects that control your actions or influence your mind as if you were affected by the spell mind blank. This effect occurs automatically as soon as it applies, lasts until it runs out or is no longer needed, and can operate multiple times per day (up to the total daily limit of rounds). This granted power is a supernatural ability.

Domain Spells: 1st—comprehend languages, 2nd—calm emotions, 3rd—suggestion, 4th—imbue with special ability, 5th—atonement, 6th—mass owl’s wisdom, 7th—greater scrying, 8th—moment of prescience, 9th—astral projection
